approved.en: Ukraine launched drones that struck Russia's largest oil refinery in Siberia, while Russia killed a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker in a drone strike and hit a Ukrainian drone strike in Russia's Smolensk region that killed two people. Russia reported intercepting 146 drones in the Leningrad region and a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. A U.S.-mediated prisoner swap was concluded in Abu Dhabi, but broader peace talks ended without a breakthrough. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ukraina lanserte droner som rammet Russlands største oljeraffineri i Sibir, mens Russland drepte en arbeider ved Zaporizjzja kjernekraftverk i et droneangrep og traff et ukrainsk droneangrep i Russlands Smolensk-region som drepte to personer. Russland rapporterte at de avskjærte 146 droner i Leningrad-regionen og en drone som såret tre energiarbeidere i Sumy oblast. Et USAs-mediert fangebytte ble avsluttet i Abu Dhabi, men bredere fredsforhandlinger endte uten gjennombrudd. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel has expanded its presence in southern Lebanon by building new road networks and opening bases, while continuing strikes on Qantara, overflights that wounded a Lebanese footballer and the detention of a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Hezbollah has arrested five members in Batroun, maintained artillery fire on Israeli positions and begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in Beirut, prompting a probe by France into alleged Israeli war crimes. UN peacekeepers are preparing to exit Lebanon as displaced families face devastation, and Israel’s actions are disrupting ecosystems, including Lebanon’s wheat crop. 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah har arrestert fem medlemmer i Batroun, opprettholdt artilleribrann mot israelske posisjoner og innført kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Den tidligere irakiske MP Ahmed al-Alwani ble funnet død i Beirut, noe som førte til en etterforskning fra Frankrike av påståtte israelske krigsforbrytelser. FN-fredsbevarere forbereder seg på å forlate Libanon mens fordrevne familier står overfor ødeleggelse, og Israels handlinger forstyrrer økosystemer, inkludert Libanons hveteavling. 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The United States struck Iran's Qeshm Island and disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, while Iran hit a building in Tel Aviv with a missile and opened a women’s war-readiness training camp. Iran also designated the Argentine navy and air force as terrorist organisations and warned of expanded retaliation against European countries hosting US bases. Qatar reported progress in US-Iran talks after a White House meeting, and France blamed Iran for a cyberattack on refrigeration systems. Defense spending is being constrained by the Iran standoff, and 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran utpekte også den argentinske marinen og luftforsvaret som terrororganisasjoner og varslet utvidet gjengjeldelse mot europeiske land som har amerikanske baser. Qatar rapporterte fremgang i US-Iran-samtaler etter et møte i Det hvite hus, og Frankrike la skylden på Iran for et cyberangrep på kjølesystemer. Forsvarsutgiftene blir begrenset av Iran-konflikten, og 123 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

An RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity is threatening Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The conflict has displaced more than 50,000 people and caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale drepte dusinvis av etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, og angrep på ortodokse kristne fortsetter i Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz og i nord, med eksplosjoner hørt i Addis Ababa. Sikkerhetsproblemer for frø truer bønder i Tigray, og et pilotprosjekt for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. approved.en: Islamic State-linked rebels killed at least 22 people in eastern DR Congo while Allied Democratic Forces militants attacked Cantine in North Kivu, adding to insecurity. A military court sentenced 66 Congolese soldiers to death for cowardice after they fled an attack by FRN rebels. Ebola cases have exceeded 11,000 with 5,387 deaths and cholera has killed 1,800 people, prompting WHO warnings. Rekrutteringen til mindre væpnede grupper har steget kraftig ettersom terrorrelaterte saker har firedoblet seg under president De la Espriella, og ICE-offiserer med rasismehistorikk er blitt involvert i drapet på en colombiansk migrant. Konflikten forblir lavintensiv med 225 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

An Ecuadorian thief pleaded guilty to participation in the largest U.S. jewelry heist, and a major Ecuadorian cocaine and weapons trafficking ring was busted in New York. These incidents show that high-profile transnational crimes and attacks on media figures are now part of the crisis, expanding beyond the prison-gang violence that previously dominated. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.

Disse hendelsene viser at høyprofilerte transnasjonale forbrytelser og angrep på mediepersoner nå er en del av krisen, og utvider seg utover den fengsels-gjeng-volden som tidligere dominerte. approved.en: Lawmakers have opened Venezuela's crisis-hit power sector to private investment, ending exclusive state control. Brazil’s Lula da Silva and Venezuela’s Delcy Rodríguez have agreed to fully reactivate bilateral ties, including oil investment talks, and Fluor has returned after a twenty-year hiatus. Conviasa will restart flights to Cuba despite fuel shortages on the island. The conflict environment still records 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
